title: Sichuan Province Beset by Numerous Fabricated AI-Generated Reports of Disasters and Crises

behaviors.text: In Sichuan, AI tools were reportedly used to create and disseminate false reports across various cities, including fabricated stories of landslides, earthquakes, standoffs, accidents, and health-related incidents.
These AI-driven rumors misled the [person], caused alarm and confusion, and strained local [person].
The alleged perpetrators sought social media engagement and financial gain through clickbait content.
The [person] in Sichuan ultimately levied administrative penalties against the perpetrators.
